_meta.title: Brief status register — S-04…S-25 and SG-27…SG-30
_meta.method: Each row has two columns that are never merged. 'Brief says' is copied from the brief. 'This repo shows' is what was measured or read in this checkout (branch arena/38650305-zone3). Rows marked 'Not found' have no matching text or file here, whatever the brief says. The brief's status labels cite the owner's Zone4 decision log (https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone4/docs/decisions.html); that log was reachable on 2026-11-17 but its individual S-rows were not re-read line by line, so 'Brief says' is not independently verified.

status_vocabulary.Verified here: Measured or read in this checkout on the date shown.
status_vocabulary.Partly here: Some of the claimed work is present; the rest is missing or not measured.
status_vocabulary.Not found here: The brief claims it, but no matching page or file exists in this checkout.
status_vocabulary.Conflict: The repo does something the brief rules out.
status_vocabulary.Blocked (owner): Needs an account, a decision or a host that this build cannot reach.
status_vocabulary.Not measured: No measurement was made this session.

rows.item: Give every page its own title and meta description
rows.this_repo_shows: All 102 published HTML pages (excluding archive/, docs/, sessions/) carry a <title> and a meta description. Measured 2026-11-17. Where a page had no description, the publish pass added a generic one built from the title (flag M38-F-05).

rows.item: Mark affiliate links rel="sponsored" without breaking the disclosure
rows.this_repo_shows: 1,444 links to amazon.* or link.amazon* on 102 pages; 0 without rel="sponsored". The disclosure strip sits under the masthead on every page (checked by tools/verify_site.py, V1).

rows.item: Add what the appliance is like to live with (original testing)
rows.brief_says: Not adopted - see the recorded decision (Zone4 D-06)
rows.this_repo_shows: No original testing or first-hand use data exists in this checkout. Consistent with 'not adopted'.

rows.brief_says: No status label in the brief
rows.this_repo_shows: Four question-shaped guides are published under guides/ (working titles). No search-query data exists in this checkout, so no question was chosen from measured queries.

rows.this_repo_shows: og:image on 11 of 102 pages; JSON-LD structured data on 11 of 102 pages (the reader-site pages under read/). No search-traffic measurement exists (see SG-29).
